creator: Ka Fai Lao
title: Kelvin's Go60 layout v28
notes:
Kelvin's Go60 layout v28.

Key Features:
- Bilateral Home Row Mods (hml/hmr): A/S/D/F and J/K/L/; (GUI, Alt, Ctrl, Shift) with 280ms tapping term, 250ms quick-tap, 150ms prior-idle, and opposite-hand trigger.
- Left Outer Column (Modes & System): td_LAYER_Keypad (Row 0), td_caps (Row 1), ESC (Row 2), Magic (Row 3).
- Right Outer Column (Punctuation): AeroSpace Maximize Cmd+Ctrl+M (Row 0), Hyphen - (Row 1), Quote ' (Row 2), Underscore _ (Row 3).
- Bottom Row:
  - Left (under X, C, V): td_copy_paste (tap for Cmd+C, double-tap for Cmd+V), Left, Right.
  - Right (under M, ,, .): Down, Up, Cmd+Space.
- Thumb Cluster (identical to Glove80 lower thumb cluster):
  - Left (Outer to Inner): LSHFT, BSPC (pure instant key; DEL on SymbolNav), TAB (hold for NumRow).
  - Right (Inner to Outer): RET, DEL (hold for SymbolNav), SPACE.

Layers:
- Base: macOS base layer (Keypad on top-left, Magic on Row 3, Copy/Paste tap-dance, Left, Right on bottom-left; Down, Up, Cmd+Space on bottom-right; AeroSpace Maximize Cmd+Ctrl+M on number-row corner).
- PC: Linux/Windows overlay layer (converts bottom-row shortcuts to Ctrl+C/V tap-dance and Ctrl+Space).
- Gaming: Disables Home Row Mods on ASDF / JKL;, keeps TAB at left of Q, puts BSPC/SPACE/DEL(hold SymbolNav for F1-F5) on bottom-left, and uses LSHFT (pass-through), LCTRL, Alt/Ret on left thumb.
- SymbolNav: Left-hand brackets/quotes/symbols, Home/End on left outer column (left of @ and ~), Right-hand Vim HJKL arrows, math/comparison operators (& + - * \ and = ^ < > $), F1-F12, PageUp/PageDown below F12, and DEL on Left Thumb T2.
- Keypad: 3x3 digit block shifted right to UJM (741), IK, (852), OL. (963) with 456 on home-row JKL. Right thumb Enter keys (0 removed). Left pinky toggles off.
- NumRow: Hold Left Thumb T3 (TAB) for home-row numbers 1-0 on A-G / H-;.
- Magic: Volume on U/I/O (Dn/Up/Mute), Bluetooth profiles (BT_0 -> Base/macOS, BT_1 -> PC/Linux-Win), layer toggles (Gaming, PC), RGB controls, Insert/ScrollLock/PrintScreen on right bottom row, and bootloader/reset.

Per-Key RGB (underglow-layer):
- Caps Lock status: td_caps glows red when Caps Lock is active (in Base & NumRow).
- Momentary layers (SymbolNav, NumRow, Magic) and Keypad stay color-coded while active (PageUp/PageDown light up Magenta; Keypad right thumbs light up Orange).
- Permanent layers (PC, Gaming) light up for 3 seconds on toggle and fade out (Gaming only lights up modified keys, avoiding ghost RGB on pass-through W and LSHFT).
